summary: Iter 14 — frontend-only e2e validation of the dual full-size canvas restructure in ProMappingStudio. Verified: (1) studio-split contains both studio-mapping-pane and studio-preview-pane as siblings. (2) Both studio-canvas and studio-preview-canvas measure ~540×~698.8px (8.5/11 aspect, ±0 px on width, ±1 px on height) — equal dimensions confirmed. (3) Mapping canvas has objectFit='fill' (scan stretches to 8.5:11 frame for 1:1 coord parity). (4) Drawing 1 rect on mapping (frac coords 0.30→0.60 x, 0.30→0.50 y) renders 1 in studio-preview-canvas's inline

tests_executed.preview_renders_rect_after_mapping_draw: PASS (1 <rect> in preview SVG; bbox aligned to projected working-area)

critical_code_review_comments: ProMappingStudio.jsx is now ~1067 lines (well >700-line guideline). Highest-leverage extraction targets: CleanReconstructionCanvas + CleanElement + CleanTextLayer + valueForField (lines 843-1066, ~225 lines) into /app/frontend/src/components/app/CleanReconstructionCanvas.jsx; MarkupOverlay + DraftOverlay (lines 613-737, ~125 lines) into MarkupOverlay.jsx; InspectorPane + AssetsPane (lines 741-822, ~80 lines) into StudioDockPanes.jsx. That brings the main file to ~440 lines.

Ghost Overlay nests a full <CleanReconstructionCanvas width={540}> inside studio-canvas (line 519). On every schema change, BOTH canvases re-render the entire SVG. With many elements + ghost overlay enabled, this doubles rendering cost. Memoize via React.memo on CleanReconstructionCanvas keyed by elements length + boundaries hash, OR render a SINGLE shared CleanReconstructionCanvas through context.

Zoom transform is applied via inline style.transform on studio-split (line 457). Because transform-origin='top center' and width='fit-content', the parent .flex-1.overflow-auto can scroll horizontally at 1.25/1.5 — but pointer events still hit-test correctly because getBoundingClientRect accounts for transforms. Worth a comment in the code so future devs don't 'fix' this.

studio-zoom step is +0.25 (line 353/359). Spec text says 'click in twice → 125%' which is only true in the OUT→IN→IN sequence (75→100→125). From default 100% two clicks land at 150% (1.0+0.25+0.25, clamped). Behavior matches the spec when executed as the spec describes; not a bug, just a sequencing nuance worth documenting in the toolbar tooltip.

Ghost Overlay rendering uses an absolute-positioned <div> with opacity:0.32 on top of the scan + the regular MarkupOverlay <svg>. Z-stacking is fine, but the overlay div has pointer-events implicitly inherited; the parent uses 'pointer-events-none' (line 517), correctly preserving tap routing to the canvas — verified.

Removed top-of-pane tabs (studio-tabs / studio-tab-clean / studio-tab-inspector) — verified gone. CleanReconstructionPreview function (lines 824-835) is now dead code (replaced by direct CleanReconstructionCanvas embed at line 534). Recommend deletion.
Bottom dock max-height is 200px (line 574). Inspector list with >7 elements scrolls inside the dock — fine, but no visual indicator (e.g. fade) that there's more content below.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Restructure is solid: studio-split is the single transform host (line 453-461) so both canvases scale together by the same factor; objectFit:'fill' on the scan (line 479) makes mapping coords match the 8.5:11 frame exactly, and CleanReconstructionCanvas renders at width=540 (line 534) into the same frame so a tap at frac (x,y) on mapping is the same frac (x,y) source for the preview — true 1:1 per spec. Ghost-overlay correctly nests another CleanReconstructionCanvas at width=540 inside studio-canvas (line 519) at opacity=0.32, with pointer-events-none so taps still route to the canvas. Bottom dock dockOpen state defaults false (line 41) and tab clicks set both dockTab and dockOpen=true so the panes mount only after explicit user intent.
